answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims at generating short summaries that capture the essentials of a long document.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L to evaluate our generated summaries against the reference. ... we report FactCC and DEP-Entail, as they are highly correlated with human judgment of factuality.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation asking Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to judge the factuality and informativeness of the summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to check whether each generated summary is factual and informative.
